How the thumbnail cache finds a picture

The thumbnail cache keeps one small picture per upload. It finds a thumbnail by a key that names the picture and its version. A new upload raises the version, so it never meets an old thumbnail.

The whole mechanism

[@upload] Every upload raises the picture's version by one. [@key] The key joins the picture's number and its version. [@serve] A request is served from the cache under that key, and a miss renders the thumbnail and stores it there.

Your questions

The table gives each question its answer in one sentence and the part that answers it.

A miss

[@without] Without the version, a re-uploaded picture meets its old thumbnail. [@with] With the version, its first request misses and renders a fresh one.
